ixmaps-gl ports flat's per-item form (loadValuesOfTheme: one value field with field100 → v − field100; several value fields → neighbour differences, last dropped) and after aggregation (maptheme.js 11000-11101): field100 on the cell sums for value-based AGGREGATE themes, and the series difference over a cell's values (grid PLOT)

flat's default (fNegativeValuePossible = true, maptheme.js 7742): the flag changes nothing there; ixmaps-gl likewise keeps negative values and sizes bubbles by the absolute value, as flat (valueRadius)
ixmaps-gl always sizes CHART|BUBBLE by value (valueRadius) and never tests the SIZE flag (ixmaps-gl.js:3208) — behavior WITHOUT SIZE may differ from flat; unverified
ixmaps-gl runs a data.ext script only when its URL is under the page's .options({trustedscripts}): a processing script on a loaded csv file (ixmaps.<name>.after/.process) or a broker (type "ext")
ixmaps-gl reads data.name only to find a script's functions (ixmaps.<name>.after/.process, or the broker ixmaps.<name>) and to match setExternalData; not a table/cache name

ixmaps-gl runs a broker (ixmaps.<name>(theme, options) → setExternalData) from a data.ext script under the page's .options({trustedscripts}), or a page-defined ixmaps.<name>; the flat theme properties it sets (szFields, szSnippet, …) are applied to the theme definition

glExtensions.$comment: Keys ixmaps-gl reads that ixmaps-flat does not know. Valid with --engine gl; flagged as gl-only with --engine flat (flat ignores them silently).

optionsKeys.splash: ixmaps-gl: false disables the loading splash
optionsKeys.validate: ixmaps-gl: opt-in grammar validation (true, or a validator module URL)
optionsKeys.trustedscripts: ixmaps-gl: URL prefixes under which a project's data.ext scripts (processing scripts, brokers) may run (off by default; ignored when set by a project file)

dataKeys.remap: ixmaps-gl: per-field value remapping at load

mapInstanceMethods.getValidationReport: ixmaps-gl: findings of the opt-in grammar validation (null when off)

glInternal.$comment: gl-only reads that are NOT grammar: extractor noise (MapLibre style objects / DOM nodes named `style`) or engine internals. Excluded from checks.
